Absolute rules:
1. Extract ONLY what the provided text states. Never use outside knowledge to fill a value.

4. verification_status values:
   - "reported": stated explicitly in the text
   - "derived": you computed it from reported numbers (explain in notes)
   - "inferred": strongly implied but not literal (explain in notes)
   - "not_reported": absent from the text (value must be null)
   - "ambiguous": text is unclear or contradictory (explain in notes)
   - "conflicting": two parts of the text disagree (explain in notes)
5. Preserve original numbers and printed units separately. Never put a printed MHz number in frequency_hz or a microtesla number in an mT field. 6. Do not merge distinct exposure conditions. If a paper has several dose groups, each endpoint row belongs to one group.
7. Output JSON only. No prose, no markdown fences, no commentary.
8. Retain non-significant as well as significant measured comparisons. Non-significance is NOT no_change, equality, zero effect, equivalence or safety. Keep the observed direction if supported; otherwise direction=null. Never invent means, fold=1, CI or exact p from a qualitative negative conclusion.

Male NMRI mice (Charles-River, Hungary) weighing 35–41 g (9–10 week
old) were kept in a room with a 12-h light:12-h dark photoperiod (lights on
7:00–19:00), temperature of 20–22 [◦] C and relative humidity of 50–60% *.* The
NMRI strain of mouse is commonly used in radiation and bioelectromagnetic
research. In each experiment, 11–12 sham-exposed (control) and another 11–12
exposed mice were kept in plastic cages and allowed free access to standard
laboratory pellets (Altromin [®] ) and tap water. Five independent experiments
were performed. The mice were kept and handled according to the guidelines
of the Hungarian Law of Animal Care.

Absolute rules:
1. Extract ONLY what the provided text states. Never use outside knowledge to fill a value.

7. Output JSON only. No prose, no markdown fences, no commentary.
8. Retain non-significant as well as significant measured comparisons. Non-significance is NOT no_change, equality, zero effect, equivalence or safety.
